stories.title: NBA Rank's hottest hot-button topics -- and what league execs think about the three-player battle for No. 1
stories.summary: ESPN's NBA Rank 2026 countdown is in the books, but debates are just beginning -- on social media and around the league.

stories.title: Kyrie ready to 'kick some butt' after lengthy ACL recovery
stories.summary: Kyrie Irving said he is under no physical restrictions from the torn ACL in his left knee that sidelined him 19 months ago, an injury that he called "probably the best thing that happened to me."

stories.title: Sparks fire head coach Roberts after 2 seasons
stories.summary: The Los Angeles Sparks dismissed head coach Lynne Roberts on Friday morning after the team missed the playoffs under her leadership for the second straight season.

stories.title: NFL, NFLPA continue to monitor field conditions in Rio
stories.summary: Field experts for the NFL and the NFL Players Association have been in Brazil for days to monitor the playing surface at Maracanã Stadium, NFLPA executive director JC Tretter said in a lengthy statement on Friday.

stories.title: Texans, trying to avoid 0-3 start, rule out WR Collins again
stories.summary: The Texans will be without Pro Bowl wideout Nico Collins for the second straight week when they travel to face the Colts.
